title: Operation TrialBlazer: Why HHS Is Rewriting Clinical-Trial Rules and Biotech Competition
summary: Operation TrialBlazer is not just an FDA efficiency program. It signals that the United States is treating clinical-trial speed as part of national biotech competitiveness, with direct implications for biotech valuation, financing windows, and regulatory strategy.
